Sharia Law is incompatible with Western Civilization

Video

Texans don’t want government surveillance in their cars any more than they want corn in their cars.

As your Attorney General, I will always fight back against ridiculous government mandates that threaten our freedom.

Video

We’re seeing the consequences of decades of failed immigration policies pushed by globalists, corporatists, and the Left.

Texans need an Attorney General who will enforce the law, defend our sovereignty, and put Texans first.

Video

There are two important steps we need to take to stop the advance of Sharia law in our country:

1. PAUSE all immigration

2. Win cases in court by making it clear Islam is a political ideology, not a religion that can hide behind the First Amendment.

Video

Thank you for the support for Attorney General, @RonnyJacksonTX 🇺🇸

Proud to stand alongside you in Congress fighting to secure the border, defend Texas values, and stop taxpayer-funded abortion efforts. Texas deserves an Attorney General ready to take on the toughest fights from Day One.

Video

Every endorsement I have is earned not bought.  Grassroots Texans like JoAnn Fleming & Terri Hall, Texas gun leaders, Texas Sheriffs… countless others.  But no I have not bought the support of Austin Texas organizations…


Scott Willhite (@scott_willhite)

Roy has an awful lot of NOT Texas endorsements. DC sure does like him... 🤔
